payload.claim: `GateStatus = Literal["pass", "fail", "skip", "error"]` is a byte-for-byte duplicate of `saffron.gates.contract.GateStatus` rather than an import of it. Nothing keeps the two definitions in sync if the canonical gate-contract vocabulary ever changes, so `GateResult.status` here could silently drift from the enumeration it is documented (line 121) to mirror.
